simple.meaning: בֶּקַע (beqaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a section (half) of a shekel, i.e. a beka (a weight and a coin).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֶּקַע (H1235) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 24:22, with occurrences in Genesis, Exodus.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּקַע (H1235) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֶּקַע (H1235) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֶּקַע (beqaʻ) / H1235 is traced through Genesis 24:22, Exodus 38:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1235. beqa בֶּ֫קַע noun [masculine] fraction, half , i.e. half-shekel, a weight; מִשְׁקָלוֺ בֶּקַע Gen 24:22 , compare Hesychius in Lag Ges. Abh 199, 1. 18 βακαίον [Lag βέκαον ] μέρον τι ; see also בֶּקַע Exod 38:26 (= הַשֶּׁקֶל מַחֲצִית ).
